verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution under a 'mobile-ios/build' docs path, which accepts contactless in-person payments on the iPhone and processes them on Adyen. Its marketing also says compatible smartphones or tablets can become Tap to Pay checkouts. However, the evidence never explicitly names an official mobile SDK, and Android embedding is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit official iOS/Android SDK documentation, evidence of an Android in-app integration, details on embedding into a merchant's own app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
